profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. Its Autonomous Knowledge Platform is presented as making AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale. The company says its product and service portfolio helps organizations use AI, analytics, and cloud solutions for accelerated innovation and sustainable growth, and that it partners with leading providers to deliver technology and AI-driven resources.

Teradata is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under ticker TDC, with SEC CIK number 0000816761. It is also known as Teradata Corp. Legal exposure records show 281 entries in California.
